title: Towards the Generalizability of Leveraging ChatGPT in APR via Self-enhancing: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.22844v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) increasingly relies on Large Language Models (LLMs). ChatGPT-enhanced APR uses techniques such as self-correction and autonomous agents to improve repair without modifying model parameters. Although these approaches report strong results on Defects4J and SWE-bench, the stability of enhancement gains across benchmarks remains under-explored. We evaluate three ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on three representative, long-standing benchmarks. With GPT-3.5-Turbo, SRepair achieves a larger absolute gain on HumanEval-Java than on Defects4J, while SRepair and FixAgent without extrinsic information yield negative gains on BugsInPy. With GPT-5.4-mini, the evaluated methods achieve larger absolute gains on Defects4J than on HumanEval-Java, while gains on BugsInPy are non-negative but limited. translated_abstract: 自动程序修复（APR）日益依赖大型语言模型（LLM）。ChatGPT增强的APR采用自我纠错和自主智能体等技术来改进修复效果，而无需修改模型参数。尽管这些方法在Defects4J和SWE-bench上报告了出色的结果，但增强收益在不同基准测试之间的稳定性仍未得到充分探索。我们在三个具有代表性且历史悠久的基准测试上评估了三种ChatGPT增强的APR方法。使用GPT-3.5-Turbo时，SRepair在HumanEval-Java上的绝对增益大于在Defects4J上的增益，而不使用外部信息的SRepair和FixAgent在BugsInPy上产生了负增益。使用GPT-5.4-mini时，所评估的方法在Defects4J上的绝对增益大于在HumanEval-Java上的增益，而在BugsInPy上的增益为非负但有限。我们通过代码转换和针对基准的微调来研究基准相关因素。代码转换……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该实证研究评估了三种ChatGPT增强的自动程序修复方法在三个长期使用的基准上的表现，发现其增强收益在不同基准和模型间并不稳定，并通过代码转换与基准特定微调探究了影响泛化性的基准相关因素。
en_tdlr: This empirical study evaluates three ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on three long-standing benchmarks, revealing that enhancement gains are unstable across benchmarks and models, and investigates benchmark-related factors through code transformations and benchmark-specific fine-tuning.
